incidents.title: Excavator swung toward a labourer standing inside the swing radius
incidents.immediate_action: Work stopped; swing radius barricaded with a spotter
incidents.root_cause: Swing radius not barricaded on the pour plan

actions.action: Toolbox talk and stand-down: excavator hazard
Correct the cause: swing radius not barricaded on the pour plan

incidents.title: Concrete splash to the eye during a pump pour
incidents.immediate_action: Eye flushed at the eyewash station; returned to work
incidents.root_cause: Goggles not worn under the face shield

actions.action: Toolbox talk and stand-down: concrete hazard
Correct the cause: goggles not worn under the face shield

incidents.title: Forearm punctured on an uncapped rebar dowel
incidents.immediate_action: First aid on site, taken to the clinic; three sutures
incidents.root_cause: Rebar caps missing after the dowels were cut
whys: Why did it happen? Forearm punctured on an uncapped rebar dowel
Why? Rebar caps missing after the dowels were cut
Why? The task plan did not call out the hazard
Why? The JSA was copied from a previous task

actions.action: Toolbox talk and stand-down: forearm hazard
Correct the cause: rebar caps missing after the dowels were cut

incidents.title: Crane outrigger pad cracked on soft ground
incidents.immediate_action: Lift stopped; crane re-set on timber mats
incidents.root_cause: Ground bearing not checked after rain

actions.action: Toolbox talk and stand-down: crane hazard
Correct the cause: ground bearing not checked after rain

incidents.title: Bolt bag dropped from the second tier, landed outside the barricade

actions.action: Toolbox talk and stand-down: bolt hazard
Correct the cause: bolt bag not tethered

incidents.title: Lower back strain moving a pipe spool by hand
incidents.immediate_action: Reported to the medic; referred to the clinic; restricted to light duty
incidents.root_cause: Spool moved by hand instead of with the telehandler
whys: Why did it happen? Lower back strain moving a pipe spool by hand
Why? Spool moved by hand instead of with the telehandler
Why? The task plan did not call out the hazard
Why? The JSA was copied from a previous task

actions.action: Toolbox talk and stand-down: lower hazard
Correct the cause: spool moved by hand instead of with the telehandler

incidents.title: Grinding spark burn to the wrist
incidents.root_cause: Glove cuff not over the sleeve

actions.action: Toolbox talk and stand-down: grinding hazard
Correct the cause: glove cuff not over the sleeve

incidents.title: Unsecured grating panel moved under foot at the rack edge
incidents.root_cause: Grating clips not installed after the panel was lifted

actions.action: Toolbox talk and stand-down: unsecured hazard
Correct the cause: grating clips not installed after the panel was lifted

incidents.title: Splinter in the palm from a cable reel

actions.action: Toolbox talk and stand-down: splinter hazard
Correct the cause: damaged reel flange

incidents.title: Finger fractured between a beam and a column flange during fit-up
incidents.immediate_action: First aid; taken to the clinic; X-ray confirmed fracture
incidents.root_cause: Hand placed in the pinch point while the beam was landed
whys: Why did it happen? Finger fractured between a beam and a column flange during fit-up
Why? Hand placed in the pinch point while the beam was landed
Why? The task plan did not call out the hazard
Why? The JSA was copied from a previous task

actions.action: Toolbox talk and stand-down: finger hazard
Correct the cause: hand placed in the pinch point while the beam was landed

incidents.title: Pickup reversed into a handrail at the site entrance

actions.action: Toolbox talk and stand-down: pickup hazard
Correct the cause: no spotter while reversing

incidents.title: Heat stress symptoms during afternoon work
incidents.immediate_action: Cooled in the shade, fluids; returned to work next day
incidents.root_cause: Water-rest-shade plan not followed on the rack

actions.action: Toolbox talk and stand-down: heat hazard
Correct the cause: water-rest-shade plan not followed on the rack

first_aid: Drinking fluids for relief of heat stress

incidents.title: Energised 120 V receptacle found in a circuit shown as isolated
incidents.immediate_action: Work stopped; circuit isolated and verified
incidents.root_cause: Lock applied to the wrong breaker; no test-before-touch

actions.action: Toolbox talk and stand-down: energised hazard
Correct the cause: lock applied to the wrong breaker; no test-before-touch

incidents.title: Metal particle in the eye
incidents.immediate_action: Removed by irrigation at the medic station

actions.action: Toolbox talk and stand-down: metal hazard
Correct the cause: safety glasses without side shields

first_aid: Foreign body removed from the eye by irrigation

incidents.title: Dropped shackle from 20 ft landed inside barricade
incidents.description: Dropped shackle from 20 ft landed inside barricade.
incidents.root_cause: Shackle not secured to the tag line; lift plan did not call for tool tethering.

actions.action: Add tool and rigging tethering to lift plans above 6 ft
